_comment: Reconciled against the actual designed *_test.md files from workflow run #4 (run #2's designed-then-executed cycle) — see scripts/test_data.py's module docstring for the two fixture mechanisms in play: server-side pre-seeding (self_booked_slot_time, other_patient_booked_slot_time — zero agent-interpretation risk) and in-session prose instructions (patient_with_booked_appointments, patient_with_cancelable_appointment — proven to work by review-booked-appointments' passing run, but see README for the one case where it didn't).

doctor_short_bio.value: Primary care and annual wellness visits.

self_booked_slot_time._note: Pre-booked server-side by scripts/test_data.py's preseed_bookings() before the suite starts — must match PRESEED_SELF_BOOKED_SLOT there. Previously an in-session instruction; run-4 showed the agent never carried it out.

other_patient_booked_slot_time._note: Pre-booked server-side before the suite starts by scripts/test_data.py's preseed_other_patient_booking() — must match PRESEED_DOCTOR_ID/PRESEED_OTHER_PATIENT_SLOT there.

patient_session.value: No sign-in is needed on this site.
patient_session._note: Run-4 showed the earlier negated phrasing ('not applicable... without any authentication') got misread as sign-in BEING required in 2 of 3 tests that use this variable — keep this short and positively framed.

patient_with_no_appointments.value: a fresh browser session with no prior bookings — no setup needed, proceed directly

patient_with_booked_appointments.value: a fresh browser session where you first book exactly two appointments before proceeding to Step 1: (1) open http://localhost:5050/doctor/kim and book Dr. Grace Kim for appointment type 'New Patient' at slot 2026-09-21 08:00; (2) open http://localhost:5050/doctor/holt and book Dr. Derek Holt for appointment type 'Follow-up' at slot 2026-09-21 16:00. Complete both bookings first, in this same session, then continue to Step 1.

patient_with_cancelable_appointment.value: a fresh browser session where you first book exactly one appointment before proceeding to Step 1: open http://localhost:5050/doctor/chen and book Dr. Liam Chen for appointment type 'New Patient' at slot 2026-09-21 13:00. Complete that booking first, in this same session, then continue to Step 1; this is the appointment that is safe to cancel.

baseline_tile_count._note: General Medicine's doctor count at the default per_page=6 — the test's own 'capture baseline' step 2 does NOT resolve this at runtime (confirmed by run-4's failure record: the literal string was left unresolved) — must be a real value matching specialty_listing_fixture's current doctor count.

baseline_first_doctor._note: Alphabetically-first doctor in General Medicine (default sort=name) — same runtime-resolution caveat as baseline_tile_count.
